Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results regarding Bill Clinton's governorship. While the search results confirmed Bill Clinton was the governor of Arkansas from 1983 to 1992 (which covers the time Suettinger served as NIO in 1997-1998), the Planner erroneously concluded that the governor was Mike Huckabee (who served 1996–2007). This was a hallucination/factual error where the Planner ignored the explicit confirmation from multiple sources (Britannica, Encyclopedia of Arkansas) stating Bill Clinton was the governor during the relevant period, leading to the wrong final answer (Mike Huckabee instead of William Jefferson Clinton).
